{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Spain|Cuisine of Spain]]

'''Gazpacho''' is a hearty [[Cookbook:Soup|soup]] that is served cold, making it a perfect way to cool down and replenish the body on a hot, summer day. This is the classic gazpacho recipe, but there are many other variations. Gazpacho is typically served along with the main course, or afterward. Some Spaniards serve it in a glass, as a beverage to accompany the meal.

==Ingredients==

=== Soup ===
* 2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (50 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) 2–3 day-old white bread (optional—leave out for a thinner soup)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (450 g) [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], skinned and quartered
* ½ lb (225 g) [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|green bell peppers]], seeded and trimmed
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumber]], peeled and cut in chunks
* 1 clove of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* ½ mild [[Cookbook:Onion|Spanish onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] white or red [[Cookbook:Wine vinegar|wine vinegar]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile pepper]], seeds removed (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Cilantro|Cilantro]] (optional)
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Pint|pt]] (2.4 [[Cookbook:Deciliter|dl]]) iced water
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Sea salt]]
* [[Cookbook:pepper|Black pepper]]
* Ice cubes

=== Garnish ===
* 1 tomato, skinned and diced fine
* ½ green bell pepper, diced fine
* ¼ peeled cucumber, diced fine
* bread

==Procedure==

=== Soup ===
# If using, tear up the bread, and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Squeeze it dry.
# [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Blend]] bread, tomatoes, bell peppers, cucumber, garlic, onion, vinegar, olive oil, chiles, cilantro, and water in a blender until roughly chopped. The soup should have texture and discernible vegetable bits, so do not chop too finely.
# Pour soup into a large bowl with some ice, and season to taste with salt and pepper.

=== Garnish ===
# Dice the bread, and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] it in a little olive oil until brown.
# [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] the other vegetables finely.
# Serve all garnishes in separate little bowls on the table.

=== Serving ===
# Serve gazpacho chilled.
# Allow diners to sprinkle on their own toppings.
